context.audience: young couples looking for their first home

concept: Not rooms, a day: morning light in the kitchen, evening on the balcony — a life you can picture.
plan_outline: 1. WS · eye · push in · living room at morning · sun through sheer curtains across a wooden floor (5 s)
2. MS · eye · pan · open kitchen · a kettle steaming, light on the counter (4 s)
3. WS · eye · static · bedroom · a made bed, plants by the window, a soft breeze in the curtain (4 s)
4. MS · eye · track · balcony at golden hour · two cups of tea on a small table, the city beyond (5 s)
5. WS · eye · pull back · living room at night · warm lamps on, the room cosy (5 s)
6. End card (page) · the listing's facts exactly as the user gives them (4 s)
why: A tour told as one day turns square metres into a feeling; the light tells the time.
Slow, steady moves suit interiors and the models render them cleanly; no people needed.
The listing's facts go on a page; nothing about the property is invented.
